clue.text: Account presented by pubs for wine

indicators.note: the account comes from the pubs, so their word stands in front of it

parts.note: pubs are bars

explanation.surface: A bar bill handed over for some wine.
explanation.definitionFit: Barsac is a sweet white Bordeaux, a type of dessert wine.

clue.text: A liberal president without distinction

parts.note: Ike was the nickname of US President Dwight Eisenhower

explanation.surface: A liberal head of state who lacks any distinction.
explanation.definitionFit: Treated in the same way, with no difference made between them.

clue.text: Firm set out publicity in haste

indicators.note: out signals the letters of the word set are thrown out of order

parts.note: an ad is a piece of publicity
doing something fast is doing it in haste

explanation.surface: A company hurriedly puts out its advertising.
explanation.definitionFit: Firm in the sense of resolute and unwavering, a synonym.

clue.text: Sound European money order

indicators.note: Sound tells us the word for a European is to be heard, not read

parts.note: a Czech is a European from the Czech Republic

explanation.surface: A solid European money order.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sound' looks like an adjective (reliable) but signals the homophone.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank draft instructing payment is a written order to pay money.

clue.text: In Irish county see Scottish cow

indicators.note: In places the word for see within the Irish county

parts.note: Galway is a county in the west of Ireland
lo is an old word meaning see or behold

explanation.surface: Spotting a Scottish cow in an Irish county.
explanation.definitionFit: A hardy black hornless breed of beef cattle from south-west Scotland.

clue.text: Disclose secret intention to hand over bag?

definitions.meaning: to reveal a plan you meant to keep hidden
game is hunted animals and the bag is the hunter's haul, so handing it over is literally parting with it

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for letting slip a hidden plan; read literally it is giving away hunted quarry.

clue.text: Parrot's strange role, involved with kite

indicators.note: strange suggests the combined letters of role and kite become something odd

explanation.surface: A parrot oddly cast in a part alongside a bird of prey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'involved with' just joins the two pieces of fodder; 's is 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A lorikeet is a small brightly coloured Australasian parrot.

clue.text: Ready to start playing in attack

definitions.meaning: an actor waiting on the set is ready for filming to begin
an attack or assault, the start of an onslaught

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words, on set is ready to perform; as one, an onslaught.

clue.text: Relative in charge holds article to be genuine

indicators.note: holds means the relative wraps around the article

parts.note: an aunt is a relative
the is the definite article

explanation.surface: A family member in authority insists an item is real.
explanation.definitionFit: Authentic and genuine are synonyms: real, not counterfeit.

clue.text: Con the Vicar of Bray, for example?

definitions.meaning: a convict serves time in prison

definitions.text: the Vicar of Bray, for example?
definitions.meaning: the vicar of the song kept changing his allegiance to suit whoever ruled, an opportunist

explanation.walkthrough: The Vicar of Bray is an English folk song about a clergyman who switched creed with each monarch to keep his living.
explanation.definitionFit: An opportunist who shifts views to suit the times; split in two it describes a prisoner.

clue.text: Street provides odd characters, that is, even in this location

indicators.note: the street abbreviation fills the odd-numbered places of the answer

parts.note: IE is the abbreviation for id est, that is
IE is the abbreviation for id est, that is

explanation.surface: A street with eccentric residents is, oddly, where we are.
explanation.walkthrough: ST supplies letters one and three, and IE ('that is'), 'even', supplies letters two and four, so the two pairs alternate.
explanation.definitionFit: A site is a place or position where something is located.

clue.text: Adapt again to study? Precisely

parts.note: to read a subject is to study it
just means precisely, as in just so

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to adjust to a new course.
explanation.definitionFit: To adjust once more, altering to suit changed conditions.

clue.text: Singular issue brought up by a queen

definitions.text: Singular issue brought up by a queen

parts.words: Singular issue brought up by a queen
parts.note: a queen is also a female cat, and her single offspring is what she rears

explanation.definitionFit: A young cat, the issue of a queen cat.

clue.text: Reportedly breed a flightless bird

indicators.note: Reportedly tells us the word for breed is heard rather than written

parts.note: to rear animals is to breed them

explanation.surface: Rumour has it someone is raising a bird that cannot fly.
explanation.walkthrough: The homophone works in non-rhotic British speech, where the final R is not pronounced.
explanation.definitionFit: A large South American running bird, related to the ostrich, that cannot fly.

clue.text: Instrument originally helping doctor employed in plant

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of helping
employed in places the doctor inside the plant

parts.note: arnica is a plant of the daisy family used in remedies
MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A medic using a herbal remedy plays a musical instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A mouth organ is a musical instrument.

clue.text: Deplore former City levy

parts.note: ex means former
EC is the postcode of the City of London
a rate is a local tax or levy

explanation.surface: Grumbling about an old London financial-district tax.
explanation.walkthrough: The City is London's financial district, whose postcodes begin EC.
explanation.definitionFit: To execrate is to curse or detest, a strong form of deploring.

clue.text: Reply saying what conjurer did with lady sawn in half?

definitions.text: saying what conjurer did with lady sawn in half?
definitions.meaning: the magician put her back together, said in a dropped-h accent as re-joined 'er

explanation.definitionFit: A rejoinder is a retort; read as speech it describes reassembling the lady.

clue.text: Couple permitted to form band

parts.note: a brace is a pair or couple
let means allowed or permitted

explanation.surface: A pair are allowed to start a musical group.
explanation.definitionFit: A bracelet is a band worn round the wrist.

clue.text: Standards achieved by review I presented in time

parts.note: a crit is a critique or review

indicators.note: presented in places the letter I within the period of time

parts.note: an era is a period of time

explanation.surface: Standards met by a critic presenting a review on time.
explanation.definitionFit: Criteria are the standards by which things are judged.

clue.text: Ketch possibly displaying flag

definitions.meaning: ... Ketch was a notorious English hangman, so Ketch is a surname whose first name fits
a small flag flown on a ship

explanation.walkthrough: 'Ketch' wants to be the two-masted boat; it is the 17th-century executioner Jack Ketch.
explanation.definitionFit: The executioner's forename, and a ship's small national flag.

clue.text: Bird accepted bait — a tasty morsel

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
a fish that bit took the bait

explanation.surface: A small bird takes the bait and gets a treat.
explanation.definitionFit: A titbit is a small delicious piece of food.

clue.text: Is able to run back after cold drink

indicators.note: after places the reversed words behind the cold letter

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

indicators.note: back means the words for is able and to run are read in reverse

parts.note: can means is able
to go is to run, as an engine does

explanation.surface: A cold drink after being able to jog back.
explanation.definitionFit: Cognac is a French brandy, an alcoholic drink.

clue.text: Relative peace finally discovered in agreeable surroundings

indicators.note: in, with surroundings, puts the letter inside the pleasant word

parts.note: nice means agreeable

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of peace

explanation.surface: A family member finds peace at last in pleasant surroundings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'discovered' and 'surroundings' dress the container: the final E of 'peace' is put in NICE.
explanation.definitionFit: A niece is a relative, a sibling's daughter.

clue.text: Fit for selection for match

explanation.definitionFit: Qualified to be chosen, and suitable as a marriage partner.

clue.text: Fellow commonly associated with 19 in army

definitions.meaning: A man's name, and a fellow is a man
...-jack is army slang for a ... corporal, so this word goes with jack

explanation.definitionFit: A man's name, and the first half of the army slang term lance-jack.

clue.text: Take risks? They are usually spotted

definitions.meaning: to ... with danger is to gamble
gaming cubes are marked with spots

explanation.definitionFit: To gamble, and the spotted cubes used in games.

clue.text: Honest canon provided with living

parts.note: a canon is a law or rule
abiding means dwelling or living

explanation.surface: A truthful clergyman is given a parish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'canon' and 'living' suggest a clergyman and his benefice; canon is a rule and living is dwelling.
explanation.definitionFit: Obeying the law, upright and honest.

clue.text: Attempt to frame a trial piece of needlework

indicators.note: to frame means the attempt word surrounds the rest

parts.note: a try is an attempt
a pest is a trial or nuisance

explanation.surface: Trying to mount a trial sample of embroidery.
explanation.definitionFit: A woven or embroidered wall hanging, a piece of textile work.

clue.text: Elder, perhaps, holding posh new vessel

indicators.note: holding means the plant contains the letter for posh

parts.note: the elder is a kind of tree
U means upper-class or posh

explanation.surface: An older person holds a smart new pot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Elder' looks like an older person; it is the shrub-tree.
explanation.definitionFit: A tureen is a deep serving dish, a vessel for soup.
